main.description: Invite an account to become a moderator of a community this instance hosts. The caller must be the community's owner or an instance admin. The invitation is AppView state, not a record: nothing is written to the community's repo and the roster does not change until the invitee accepts. The invitee is notified. The invitation lapses 14 days after it is made; a newer invitation to the same account in the same community replaces it. The actor is the authenticated account, never a request field.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither the community's owner nor an instance admin, or the community is not hosted here or is removed; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed: community is not a DID, subject is empty, expectedVersion is negative or idempotencyKey is empty or too long; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: AccountNotFound
errors.description: The subject handle does not resolve to an account.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is not the community's current roster version, or the indexed roster is behind the community's repo; refetch the roster version before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: InviteeHasRole
errors.description: The subject already holds a role in the community.

errors.name: InviteeBanned
errors.description: The invited account has a community ban in force in this community.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service or the community's repo is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same idempotency key.

subject.description: Handle or DID of the account to invite; a handle is resolved through this instance's identity resolution

expectedVersion.description: The community's roster version the caller expects

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a retry of the same request return its first result; scoped to the caller and the community

output.description: The invitation, stored before the response returns. The roster does not change until the invitee accepts.

version.description: The community's roster version, unchanged by the invitation
